claim: An ambient sound sprite's loudness depends only on its straight-line 3D distance to the listener inside its data1..data2 range; walls, floors and sectors do not stop it. A sewer stacked under a street is heard on the street: Gravesend heard 62 of its 97 ambiences, the sewers' own, in the streets above them. Height barely counts: x and y are divided by 16 but z by 256, so a sound 53,248 below is as near as one 3,328 away across the floor.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/asound.cpp:66-74 ambProcess: nDist = ksqrt of dx>>4, dy>>4, dz>>8, no occlusion
NBlood/source/blood/src/sfx.cpp:73-79 Calc3DValues divides dx, dy by 16 and dz by 256 for every other sound too
arithmetic in projects/blood-city/references/sewers-outside.md: a floor 53,248 below is 208 distance units, as near as 3.25 plan units across
use: Keep a stacked level's ambiences short-ranged, or place what lies under another place elsewhere in plan and join it by links only (the release map moves the whole underside away by a whole number of floor-tile periods).

checked.how: asound.cpp:65-74 read in ambProcess (from :50): dx>>=4, dy>>=4, dz>>=8, nDist = ksqrt(...), volume scale(nDist, data1, data2, vs, 0) - no sector or wall test. sfx.cpp:72-79 in Calc3DValues (from :64) the same shifts. release.py:5-6 docstring: '62 of the city's 97 ambiences, the sewers' own, were heard on its streets'; sewers-outside.md:16-17 53,248 z = 208 units = 3.25 plan units; 208 x 16 = 3,328 as claimed.
